root_cause: External verifier incorrectly queried workflow_dispatch with candidate head_sha even though GitHub indexes it under protected main SHA; duplicate dispatch landed in PR-scoped cancel-in-progress:true and cancelled the existing original verification.
fix: Original terminal must match exact candidate PR and head in display_title from main-indexed workflow_dispatch runs, read provider status twice, fail closed when provider read unavailable, reuse prior active flight. Verification-only workflow concurrency must never cancel in-progress existing PR flight; native source-updating PR delivery cancellation remains intact. External agents must use the original terminal, never ad-hoc duplicate dispatch.
prevention_rule: Before any BRAIN verification_only dispatch, inspect all relevant active native workflow runs by original workflow ID on protected main, match exact PR+candidate SHA in run display title/inputs, reread status, and OBSERVE rather than DISPATCH when one exists. A redundant verify-only run cannot cancel an existing original run.

invariants: main-indexed workflow_dispatch not indexed by candidate SHA
verification-only cannot cancel original active run
original source-updating PR cancellation semantics remain

portal_projection.required: new single original BRAIN verification result, protected merge, fresh main readback

terminal_rule: Native Required + CodeQL + full BRAIN success exact head, protected merge and original terminal readback before resolving #5332.
